remarks: Move right into this stunning, fully updated one-bedroom condo in the heart of Stamford, featuring an open and airy white kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a breakfast bar that flows seamlessly into a generous living and dining space. Enjoy access to a private balcony from both the living area and the ensuite bedroom, which boasts a full bath and a large walk-in closet. Additional highlights include an updated half bath for guests, hardwood floors, in-unit washer/dryer, and two year old heating-cooling unit. This premier residence offers fantastic amenities, including an on-site fitness center, his and hers saunas, and secured underground reserved parking. Ideally located near Ridgeway Center, Scalzi Park, top restaurants, shopping, and entertainment, with easy access to Metro North, I-95, and all that downtown Stamford has to offer-don't miss this incredible opportunity for modern city living!
